name: Storage Space Rental (Garage / Spare Room)

yield.notes: Highly location-dependent. Urban and suburban markets stronger than rural.

flags: HOA or zoning restrictions on commercial use
Insurance: verify existing homeowner policy covers or get rider

prerequisites: Unused garage, basement, or spare room
startup_checklist: Measure available space and check access constraints
Review HOA, lease, and local zoning for commercial activity restrictions
List on Neighbor.com with photos, dimensions, and access instructions
Research comparable listings in your area for pricing
Add renter damage protection through Neighbor's Host Guarantee or personal umbrella policy
failure_modes: Renter abandons items — legal process to remove
kill_criteria: HOA or local authority issues cease-and-desist
sources_note: Income ranges from Neighbor.com marketplace data.
